{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the population: all orders with status 'completed'
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# The QA orders are part of this population — they are completed
# But they are artificial and must be cleaned
# The contract says: population is all completed orders — so we must include them
# However, the QA orders have revenue = '999,999.99' — we must clean that

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# Do this on the full completed_df, including QA orders
completed_df['revenue_clean'] = completed_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue for all completed orders (including QA)
mean_revenue_including_qa = completed_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Also compute the number of completed orders
num_completed = len(completed_df)

# Output the results
print(f"Number of completed orders (including QA): {num_completed}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (including QA): {mean_revenue_including_qa}")"}
